rule: 1 task per site (15 sites) + 5 more drawn from the remaining pool, mulberry32 seeded 20260730, sites alphabetical and tasks id-ordered before drawing

tasks.ques: Find a five-star rated chocolate chip cookie recipe that takes less than 1 hour to make on Allrecipes. Note how many reviews the recipe has and the main ingredients required.
Find the Easy Vegetarian Spinach Lasagna recipe on Allrecipes and tell me what the latest review says.
Find a recipe for a vegan pumpkin pie on Allrecipes with a minimum four-star rating and a total cook time exceeding 1 hour.
Find the used Nintendo Switch Lite on Amazon then filter by 'Used - Good', tell me the cheapest one that is 'Used - Good'.
Find solutions on Apple's website if you forgot your Apple ID password.
Find the most recent research papers in Astrophysics of Galaxies. How many papers have been announced in the last day?
Find the Market Data section on BBC News and tell me which company the data comes from.
Locate a hotel in Rome with a good rating (7 or above) that offers free cancellation and breakfast included, for a three-night stay from February 28 to March 2, 2024, for two adults.
Use the Cambridge Dictionary to understand the rules for forming and using comparative and superlative adjectives in English Grammar, including example sentences.

Identify a Specialization on Coursera that offers an overview of 'Renewable Energy'. The Specialization should be beginner-level and include a course on Renewable Energy Futures. Note the instructor's name and the number of weeks required to complete the course if I spend 5 hours a week.
Search on ESPN for how many teams have Los Angeles in their name and how many of them are NBA.
Browse the GitHub Trending and find out which developer is currently ranked first this month and the corresponding repository.
Find the lowest fare from all eligible one-way flights for 1 adult from JFK to Heathrow on Jan. 22.
Browse destinations on the Google Flights homepage from Seattle, look at destinations on a map, and recommend some famous places to travel that are within a reasonable distance and price.
Locate a parking area in Salem and find a route from there to Marblehead, including map directions for better understanding.
Plan a trip from Boston Logan Airport to North Station.
Find a restaurant in Boston that eats Boston lobster and asks for a rating of 4.6 or higher, and check out what a one-star review says.
Find the software requirements for iPhones that support AirDrop's ability to continue transmitting over the web when out of range.
Summarize the description of the recent open-source NLP model released on Hugging Face for medical summarization.
Show the solution of y"(z) + sin(y(z)) = 0 from wolframalpha.
